  approximation statement in the order language (GlobalGeneration.residueDeg_eq_one_iff_hasRationalResidues
  -- a genuine iff, stands on its own). That statement is then derived for an algebraically
  closed base from the stalk residue field (hasRationalResidues_of_isAlgClosed). BUT
  that derivation takes three stalk-level instance binders -- Algebra k (stalk), IsScalarTower

  of them for its curve; the last is not node N14''s Module.Finite k (localStepTgt

  to standard stalk commutative algebra, which is where it belongs, but it did not
  go away. An earlier version of this summary said "DISCHARGED"; a fresh-context review
  corrected it.

  cone from the one-point bump alone (LedgerClosure.chi_eq_of_bump_of_nonneg). Extending
  to all divisors is proved EQUIVALENT to one identity about the negative part (chi_eq_iff_step_of_bump),
  stated as an iff precisely so it is not mistaken for a reduction. Not bookkeeping:
  chi is not additive in D (only deg_k is) and D is not linearly equivalent to D+,
  so neither transport mechanism the lane owns applies.

  structure and tower look routine given the structure morphism; the residue finiteness
  is substantive). Do not substitute the sorry until the ledger is a theorem -- doing
  so would relocate the gap while making a hypothesis-free statement depend silently
  on one.

  '
